WITH region_scope AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT region
    FROM dim_store
    WHERE channel_type = '线上商城'
),
month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ds.region,
        SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS value
    FROM fact_order fo
    JOIN dim_store ds
        ON fo.store_id = ds.store_id
    WHERE fo.order_status = '已完成'
      AND fo.pay_time >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND fo.pay_time < '2026-08-01 00:00:00'
      AND ds.channel_type = '线上商城'
    GROUP BY ds.region
)
SELECT
    rs.region AS dimension_value,
    ms.value AS `value`
FROM region_scope rs
LEFT JOIN month_sales ms
    ON rs.region = ms.region
ORDER BY rs.region

WHERE ds.channel_type = '线下加盟店'

WITH city_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT city
    FROM dim_store
    WHERE channel_type = '线下加盟店'
      AND region = '华中'
),
city_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ds.city AS city,
        SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS sales_value
    FROM fact_order fo
    JOIN dim_store ds ON fo.store_id = ds.store_id
    WHERE fo.order_status = '已完成'
      AND fo.pay_time >= '2026-07-01'
      AND fo.pay_time < '2026-08-01'
      AND ds.channel_type = '线下加盟店'
      AND ds.region = '华中'
    GROUP BY ds.city
)
SELECT
    cb.city AS dimension_value,
    cs.sales_value AS `value`
FROM city_base cb
LEFT JOIN city_sales cs ON cb.city <=> cs.city
ORDER BY cb.city
